OUR STORY

Born in the mud.
Built for the trails.

SB Racing — Soggy Bottom Racing — started in 2024 when a crew of shift workers from CF Industries in Medicine Hat needed dirt after long days at the plant. After-work laps in the coulees turned into a club: group rides, trail maps, merch, and a place to show up even when the forecast is ugly.

We ride the badlands and prairie around Medicine Hat, Redcliff, Elkwater, and Cypress Hills. Technical coulee singletrack, high-speed flow, and poker-run checkpoints on the same map. Beginners and regulars are both welcome — no ego, just good people on bikes.

The website and the official iOS app are the same club toolkit: RSVP to rides, track GPS rides with the screen locked, scan poker-run QR codes, follow the leaderboard, and keep up on Soggy Bottom HQ.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY DO
  • Group rides, clinics, socials, and poker runs — RSVP in the app or on the site
  • Trail maps for Medicine Hat, Redcliff, Elkwater & Cypress Hills
  • GPS ride tracking, saved rides, and a club leaderboard
  • Soggy Bottom HQ: photos, clips, comments, and club updates
  • Private club — apply to join, we review every application
OFFICIAL iOS APP

SB Racing on the App Store

The same club tools you use here — trails, events, ride tracking, and poker-run checkpoints — in an iPhone app. Tap Start when you roll out. The ride keeps recording with the screen locked.

  • Trail maps with difficulty and short descriptions
  • GPS tracking: distance, time, elevation, export
  • RSVP to group rides and see spots left
  • Scan poker-run QRs and follow the leaderboard
